title: 第21章 新问题出现第22章 回归现实
slug: 魔法我钢铁洪流直接平推
lines: 看到了林默带来的弓弩效果后，精灵们的热情就像被点燃的干燥林场，整个营地都沸腾了。
但这份热情，只持续了不到半天。
林默正翘着二郎腿，坐在一块被磨得油光水滑的大石头上，一边“咔嚓咔嚓”啃着精灵特产的清脆蜜果，一边盘算着时间。
这第一批武器的零件还没凑齐一套，魔族大军可别就上门收人头了。
那乐子可就太大了。
就在这时，一阵喧哗和激烈的争吵声从不远处的工坊传来。
紧接着，芬朵娜和艾尔德大师一前一后，满脸焦急地快步走了过来。
“林默阁下！”
艾尔德大师像捧着一堆废铁，将手里的金属零件“哗啦”一声全倒在石桌上，一张老脸皱成了苦瓜，
“我们……我们造不出来。”
林默挑了挑眉，将啃完的果核随手向后一弹，划出一道完美的抛物线。
“怎么了？图纸太复杂，看不懂？”
“不，图纸我们已经研究透了！”芬朵娜抢过话头，纤长的玉指在那堆零件里戳来戳去，语气里充满了无力与挫败。
“问题是，我们没办法‘大批量’制造。”
见林默似乎没明白，艾尔德大师拿起两个外形、光泽、重量都堪称一模一样的齿轮，递到林默面前。
“您看，这是我和我最出色的弟子，用同一块精金，严格遵照图纸上的尺寸，用心打造的。但是……”
他拿起其中一个齿轮，轻松地装进一个复合弓的滑轮组卡榫里，转动流畅丝滑，毫无阻滞。
完美。
紧接着，他换上另一个，只塞进去一半，就像被无形的墙壁挡住，死死卡住，进不去，也拔不出来。
“每个工匠的手，都是独一无二的。”艾尔德大师一张老脸涨得通红。
“这点微小的差别，在制作传统弓箭时，是工匠的灵魂印记，是独一无二的艺术！”
“可用在这些精密的武器上……它就是一坨该死的大粪！”
老大师情绪激动，连粗口都爆了出来。
“我们集合了十个最好的工匠，叮叮当当地忙活了一整个下午，最终只成功拼装出5把连弩！”
“还有那几把复合弓，弦一拉满，整个弓身就发出‘嘎吱嘎吱’的呻吟，好像随时都要散架！这谁敢用？”
“怕不是还没射死敌人，自己先被弓臂弹死了！”
林默瞬间懂了。
手工作坊引以为傲的“艺术”，一头撞上了工业化冰冷的“标准”，被撞得粉身碎骨。
这帮长耳朵的cpu里，压根就没写入过“公差”和“零件互换”这种底层代码。
在他们的世界观里，每件武器都必须由一个工匠从头到尾负责，零件之间讲究的是“磨合”，是“缘分”，是虚无缥缈的“感觉”。
“你们的问题，不是技术问题。”
林默把腿放下，站了起来，环视着两人。
“是思想问题。”
开玩笑，他一个接受过九年义务教育，在流水线上拧过螺丝的当代优秀青年，这点门道要是看不穿，简直愧对胸前的红领巾。
“思想？”
芬朵娜和艾尔德同时懵住，异口同声。
“对，思想。”
林默随手拿起桌上那两个“一模一样”的齿轮，在手里掂了掂。
“在你们眼里，这是两件独立的，灌注了心血的艺术品。”
艾尔德大师下意识地点头，脸上还残留着一丝属于顶尖工匠的骄傲。
content_en:
After seeing the effect of the crossbows brought by Lin Mo, the enthusiasm of the elves was like a dry forest farm being ignited, and the whole camp was boiling.
But this enthusiasm only lasted less than half a day.
Lin Mo was sitting on a large smooth rock with his legs crossed, munching on the crisp honey fruits that are a specialty of the elves, and counting the time.
Before the parts for this first batch of weapons are assembled, the demon army will come to collect people.
It was so much fun.
At this moment, a burst of noise and fierce quarrel came from the workshop not far away.
Immediately afterwards, Fenduona and Master Elder walked over quickly with anxious faces, one behind the other.
"Your Excellency Lin Mo!"
Master Elder seemed to be holding a pile of scrap metal, and poured all the metal parts in his hand onto the stone table with a "clatter", his old face wrinkled into a bitter melon,
"We...we can't make it."
Lin Mo raised his eyebrows and flicked the finished fruit core backwards, drawing a perfect parabola.
"What's wrong? The drawings are too complicated and I can't understand them?"
"No, we have already studied the drawings thoroughly!" Fenduona took the lead and poked around in the pile of parts with her slender jade fingers, her tone full of powerlessness and frustration.
"The problem is, we can't make it in large quantities."
Lin Mo:? ? ?
Seeing that Lin Mo didn't seem to understand, Master Elder picked up two gears that were exactly the same in appearance, luster, and weight, and handed them to Lin Mo.
"You see, my most outstanding disciple and I used the same piece of fine gold to build this carefully according to the dimensions on the drawing. But..."
He picked up one of the gears and easily installed it into the latch of the pulley block of a compound bow. It rotated smoothly and smoothly without any hindrance.
Perfect.
Immediately afterwards, he put on another one and only stuffed it halfway in. It was like being blocked by an invisible wall, stuck tightly, unable to get in or pull out.
"Every craftsman's hand is unique." Master Elder's old face turned red.
"This tiny difference is the mark of the craftsman's soul when making traditional bows and arrows, and it is a unique art!"
"It can be used on these sophisticated weapons...it's a bloody turd!"
The old master was so emotional that he even uttered foul language.
"We gathered ten of the best craftsmen and worked hard all afternoon, but in the end we only succeeded in assembling 5 repeating crossbows!"
"There are also those compound bows. Once the strings are fully drawn, the entire bow makes a creaking groan, as if it is about to fall apart at any time! Who dares to use these?"
"I'm afraid I haven't shot the enemy to death, and I will be shot to death by the bow arm first!"
Lin Mo understood instantly.
The "art" that the handicraft workshop was proud of ran into the cold "standards" of industrialization and was shattered to pieces.
There is no low-level code such as "tolerance" and "parts interchange" written into these long-eared CPUs.
In their world view, each weapon must be handled by a craftsman from start to finish, and what matters between the parts is "run-in", "fate", and the ethereal "feeling".
"Your problem is not a technical problem."
Lin Mo put down his legs, stood up, and looked around the two of them.
"It's a matter of thought."
Just kidding, he is an outstanding contemporary young man who has received nine years of compulsory education and has screwed screws on an assembly line. If he can't see through this, he will be ashamed of the red scarf on his chest.
"Thoughts?"
Fendona and Eld were stunned at the same time and spoke in unison.
"Yes, thoughts."
Lin Mo casually picked up the two "identical" gears on the table and weighed them in his hands.
"In your eyes, these are two independent works of art that are filled with painstaking efforts."
Master Elder nodded subconsciously, with a hint of pride belonging to a top craftsman still remaining on his face.
